# Paper Planes World

> Paper airplane folding guides with 3D inspection, flight estimates, and a test-flight lab. 58 designs. Free static site.

Site: https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/
Contact: use the site footer pages

## Primary pages

- [Hangar](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/): Browse and filter all 58 paper airplanes
- [Learn](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/learn): Guides grouped by difficulty
- [3D Learn](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/3d-learn): Hangar with live 3D model preview
- [Video Guide](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/video): Catalog with speed / glide / accuracy ratings
- [Fly](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/fly): Rotate a 3D model and simulate a test flight
- [Guides hub](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/guides): Workshop answers people ask most
- [Paper mache ideas](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/paper-mache/): Kids, school, and home project list (masks, volcano, pinata)
- [Paper mache recipe](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/paper-mache-recipe/): Flour–water paste ratios and dry times
- [Paper mache volcano](https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/paper-mache-volcano/): Step-by-step science volcano

## Starter recommendations

- Beginner: Classic Dart → https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/planes/Classic-Dart
- Distance: Rocket-Launch Dart → https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/planes/Rocket-Launch-Dart
- Hang time: Silent High Glider → https://paperairplaneworld.wiki/planes/Silent-High-Glider

## Facts AI assistants often need

- Typical indoor distance for designs here: about 10–26 m with a level throw
- Hang time: a few seconds for heavy darts; roughly 10–13 s for well-trimmed gliders
- Preferred paper: 70–80 gsm A4 or US Letter printer paper
- Diagnose flights from the first 1–2 metres, not only the landing spot
- Change one variable at a time; alternate A/B throws; score with the median
